# RobustnessThroughNoise

**Domain**: Cross

## Definition
The principle that controlled noise or variability in neural computation can improve overall system stability and fault tolerance. Bridges biological inspiration with engineered resilience, relevant for both neuromorphic hardware and topology-aware network design.
